name: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. is a Japanese producer and seller of specialized chemical goods at home and abroad, organized in four business segments. The Inks division makes offset, gravure and inkjet printing inks and functional coating materials, while the Chemicals division supplies other chemical products. It also trades commodities. Established in Tokyo in 1895, it remains headquartered there.
